scope: Bounded resumable exact-recipient mark-all-read owner command for unread and seen inbox rows

canonical_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the canonical plan without replacing unrelated concurrent task updates

policy.ownership_scope: exact non-nil tenant and recipient identities supplied by an authorized caller
policy.eligible_states: select only unread and seen rows; read and archived rows remain outside the command
policy.page_bounds: default 20 and hard maximum 64 using the shared inbox limits
policy.cursor: reuse the versioned i1 inbox cursor with nanosecond timestamp and UUID tie-breaker validation
policy.selection_boundary: complete one bounded owner-table selection before exact state mutations
policy.transition_owner: delegate every selected row to NotificationInboxStateService::mark_read
policy.timestamp_policy: direct unread-to-read assigns seen_at and read_at together while seen-to-read preserves seen_at
policy.progress: derive continuation from the last scanned raw eligible row and return scanned plus marked_read counts
policy.restart: earlier exact transitions are durable and idempotent if a later database operation fails
policy.empty_foreign_result: empty missing cross-tenant and cross-recipient scopes return an empty page without notification identity
policy.foreign_calls: mark-all-read calls no recipient privacy source provider target or delivery owner
policy.delivery_boundary: mark-all-read creates or mutates no delivery attempts
policy.response: return only scanned marked_read next_cursor and has_more without source target route or notification identity
policy.transport_boundary: no HTTP GraphQL native server function or UI adapter is delivered

not_delivered: mark-all-unread mark-all-archive and arbitrary selected-id bulk mutations
tenant-wide scheduled reconciliation and payload redaction
external inbox transport and UI adapters
search index SEO and deep-link migration
